name: app.clearpolicy/clearpolicy
title: ClearPolicy
description: Manage policy documents, collect signatures and acknowledgments, and track completion.

tools.name: list-documents-tool
tools.description: Find documents available to send for electronic signature. Use this to browse what documents the organization has ready to send.

name.description: Filter documents by name (partial match, case-insensitive).

include_archived.description: Include archived documents in the results. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get-document-tool
tools.description: Get details of a document, including how many people have signed it and how many haven't.

tools.name: get-document-revision-tool
tools.description: Get a document revision including its body and lock_version for review. Table-bearing blocks are preserved as read-only HTML in content_markdown, not round-trippable Markdown. Edit those bodies in the ClearPolicy editor or omit body_markdown when copying them to a new draft. Use the latest_draft_revision_id or latest_published_revision_id from create-document / get-document.

revision_id.description: The ULID of the document revision.

tools.name: list-groups-tool
tools.description: Find groups in the current ClearPolicy organization. Use this when an MCP client does not support resources or when the user asks to browse groups.

name.description: Filter groups by name (partial match, case-insensitive).

tools.name: get-group-tool
tools.description: Get details for one ClearPolicy group, including counts and resource URIs for its members and documents.

group_id.description: The ULID of the group to retrieve.

tools.name: list-people-tool
tools.description: Find people in the organization who can be sent documents for electronic signature. Search by name or email.

include_archived.description: Include archived people in the results. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get-person-tool
tools.description: Get a person's profile and see which documents they have or haven't signed.

tools.name: get-signing-request-tool
tools.description: Check whether a specific person has signed a document, and when.

request_id.description: The ULID of the signing request.

tools.name: list-signing-requests-tool
tools.description: Check who has signed a document and who hasn't. Filter by document, person, or status (pending, signed, expired, etc.) to track compliance.

status.description: Filter by status: pending (open), signed (completed), or an exact status (created, sent, viewed, attested, expired, canceled, bounced, failed, complained, suppressed).

tools.name: search-docs
tools.description: Search ClearPolicy customer documentation for product how-tos, guides, and API reference. Use this for "how do I…" questions (reminders, Planning Center, groups, billing, etc.). Do not use this for organization-specific data — use list/get tools instead.

query.description: Natural-language search query (e.g. "how to send reminders", "Planning Center sync").

language.description: Optional docs language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'de'). Defaults to English.

tools.name: query-docs
tools.description: Read or search ClearPolicy documentation pages via a sandboxed virtual filesystem (rg, cat, head, tree, ls, etc.). Prefer search-docs for conceptual questions; use this when you need exact page content, keyword/regex matches, or docs structure. Paths are documentation pages (e.g. /guides/reminders.mdx), not the customer organization.

command.description: Read-only shell-like command against the docs filesystem (e.g. `rg -il "reminder" /`, `head -80 /integrations/mcp.mdx`, `tree / -L 2`).

tools.name: create-document-tool
tools.description: Create a new ClearPolicy document with a draft rich-text revision. Optionally set the initial body as Markdown. Does not publish — use publish-document-revision after the user reviews the draft.

name.description: Document title as it will appear in ClearPolicy.

body_markdown.description: Optional Markdown body for the first draft. Headings, paragraphs, lists, and links are supported.

summary.description: Optional short summary of this draft revision (max 255 characters).

tools.name: update-document-revision-tool
tools.description: Update a draft document revision body (Markdown) and/or summary. Published revisions cannot be edited — create a new draft revision first. Prefer rich-text drafts created via create-document.

revision_id.description: The ULID of the draft document revision to update.

base_version.description: The lock_version returned when you last read this revision. A stale version is rejected; read and review the latest content before trying again.

body_markdown.description: Full Markdown body to store (replaces existing content). Required unless only updating summary.

summary.description: Optional short summary of this draft (max 255 characters). Pass empty string to clear.

tools.name: create-document-revision-tool
tools.description: Create a new draft revision for an existing document (for example after a version was published). If a draft already exists, returns that draft instead. File-based documents (PDF/Drive) cannot be edited as rich text via ChatGPT — use the web app.

body_markdown.description: Optional Markdown body for the new draft. If omitted, copies the previous rich-text content when available.

summary.description: Optional short summary for the draft revision.

tools.name: publish-document-revision-tool
tools.description: Publish a draft document revision so it can be sent for electronic signature. Generates a PDF and document hash. Confirm with the user before publishing. After publishing, use send-signing-request to distribute it.

revision_id.description: The ULID of the draft revision to publish.

base_version.description: The lock_version of the exact draft state reviewed and approved for publication. Read and review again if it changed.

allow_unfilled_fields.description: Only set true after telling the user which template fields are unfinished and getting explicit approval to publish with those labels still visible.

tools.name: send-signing-request-tool
tools.description: Send a document to one or more people for electronic signature. Use this when a user wants their team to sign a policy, agreement, or compliance document.

document_id.description: The ULID of the document to send.

person_ids.description: Array of person ULIDs to send the request to.

tools.name: send-reminder-tool
tools.description: Nudge someone who hasn't signed a document yet by sending them a reminder email.

request_id.description: The ULID of the signing request to send a reminder for.

tools.name: cancel-signing-request-tool
tools.description: Cancel a pending document signing request. This cannot be undone.

request_id.description: The ULID of the signing request to cancel.

tools.name: create-person-tool
tools.description: Add a new person to the current ClearPolicy organization so they can be assigned documents, added to groups, and sent signature requests.

email.description: Email address of the person. Must be unique within the organization.

tools.name: add-person-to-group-tool
tools.description: Add one person to a ClearPolicy group. When the group has automatic request issuance enabled, this assigns the group documents and sends the grouped attestation request notification for newly assigned published documents.

group_id.description: The ULID of the group to add the person to.

person_id.description: The ULID of the active person to add to the group.
